description: Read the messages visible to this agent: direct messages to it, broadcasts, and its own sent messages. Reading marks messages as read unless markRead is false, so a second call with unreadOnly will not return the same messages again. For one conversation thread in full, use bus_thread.

agent.description: Your registered agent name; you only see messages addressed to you, broadcasts, and your own.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return, newest last.

markRead.description: When true (default), returned messages are marked read. Set false to peek without changing read state.

unreadOnly.description: When true, return only messages you have not read yet.

name: bus_inbox
